content: Which agency produced the most in-force policies?

name: query_salesforce

content:
[Lakefront Brokerage Partners](/lightning/r/001aj000040t3cmAAA/view) produced the most, with **52** in-force policies worth **$1,138,520** in annual premium. That's about a third of the 156 policies in force.

| Agency | Policies | Annual premium |
|---|---|---|
| [Lakefront Brokerage Partners](/lightning/r/001aj000040t3cmAAA/view) | 52 | $1,138,520 |
| [Prairie State Insurance Agency](/lightning/r/001aj000040t3clAAA/view) | 30 | $302,786 |
| [Driftless Insurance Group](/lightning/r/001aj000040t3cnAAA/view) | 27 | $187,838 |
| No agency listed | 47 | $194,434 |

Another 47 policies in force have no agency listed.
